title: Creator Monetization Appeal Studio
oneLiner: A clean appeal-room that helps solo creators assemble proof they are original before a platform demonetization appeal.
targetUser: Solo YouTubers, animators, educational channels, and faceless creators who need to defend originality without hiring a consultant.
keyUx: Upload or paste channel evidence, tag what proves human effort, then assemble an appeal timeline with screenshots, project files, edit notes, and a calm final appeal letter.
requiredUiSections: Case status header with appeal deadline and revenue-at-risk estimate
Evidence intake rail for project files, drafts, screen recordings, timestamps, analytics, and public comments
Originality proof timeline showing human decisions across scripting, editing, recording, and publishing
Policy-risk checklist for AI voice, reused assets, repetitive formats, and disclosure gaps
Appeal packet preview with platform-ready language and attachments
Public support card generator for creators who want viewers to comment or share
stitchPrompt: Create a responsive web app prototype for “Creator Monetization Appeal Studio,” a premium appeal-room for creators defending original work after AI/inauthentic demonetization flags. Include: a case status header with appeal deadline and revenue at risk, an evidence intake rail, an originality proof timeline, a policy-risk checklist, an appeal packet preview, and a public support card generator. Design direction: use the premium-editorial profile with restrained typography, high-trust document surfaces, calm off-white space, precise dividers, and subtle creator-studio cues; it should feel like a legal-grade creative portfolio, not a generic dashboard.
